motion.$description: Phantom — the only motion on the brand mark. L01/L03/L04 · LOCKED. Three (or four) stepped Tech-Green shadows fading solid → transparent on a 3s ease-in-out cycle. Size-aware family — offsets scale with logo size. Wordmark itself stays still; only the shadow staircase breathes.

phantom-keyframes.$description: CSS keyframe definitions for the Phantom shadow family. Consume via variables.css output or apply manually via animation-name.

shadow.$value: @keyframes phantomShadow { 0%, 100% { text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #22C55E, 2px 2px 0 #22C55E, 3px 3px 0 #22C55E; } 50% { text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 transparent, 2px 2px 0 transparent, 3px 3px 0 transparent; } }

xl.$value: @keyframes phantomXL { 0%, 100% { text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #22C55E, 4px 4px 0 #22C55E, 6px 6px 0 #22C55E, 8px 8px 0 #22C55E; } 50% { text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 transparent, 4px 4px 0 transparent, 6px 6px 0 transparent, 8px 8px 0 transparent; } }

lg.$value: @keyframes phantomLG { 0%, 100% { text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #22C55E, 3px 3px 0 #22C55E, 5px 5px 0 #22C55E; } 50% { text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 transparent, 3px 3px 0 transparent, 5px 5px 0 transparent; } }

green.$value: @keyframes phantomGreen { 0%, 100% { text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } 50% { text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 transparent, 2px 2px 0 transparent, 3px 3px 0 transparent; } }
green.$description: On full-green surfaces · BLACK-rgba shadows (not white) · keeps wordmark legible on Tech Green background

color.$description: Accent text fade · for accent words inside headlines
